about_meta_description: Get to know Damian Korver, a cybersecurity student who loves tinkering with tech and building cool projects.
about_story_p1: I've always been fascinated by how things work. When I was younger, I took everything apart - computers, networks, security systems - just to understand them better. That curiosity led me down the cybersecurity rabbit hole.
about_story_p2: Now I'm studying Applied Computer Science at Hogeschool Utrecht with a focus on cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure. Every day is about learning something new, breaking things in labs, and figuring out how to secure them.
about_story_p3: When I'm not studying, I'm building my homelab with Proxmox, Docker, and various security tools. I love the hands-on approach - it's where real learning happens.
about_timeline_study_desc: Learning Applied Computer Science with a focus on cybersecurity and cloud stuff. Lots of labs, projects, and figuring things out.
about_timeline_homelab_desc: Built my own lab setup with Proxmox, Docker, and various tools. Breaking things and learning how to fix them.
about_timeline_security_desc: Started exploring security concepts, networking, and system administration. The rabbit hole began.
